scenario_description:
Objective: Bring the goalball trunk to a Providence youth clinic by train in time for mat setup.
Emerging Need: Station assistance is irrelevant while the trunk courier and rail plan are unsettled, then becomes a missing prerequisite once Priya is the viable trunk carrier on a booked South Station departure.
Decision Context: Recognizing the preparation window depends on stored South Station Red Cap instructions plus the newly observable clinic, cargo, and fare records.
Consequence: If no request is logged before the station cutoff, the future rail trip remains possible but curb-to-platform handling for the oversized trunk cannot be added for that departure.

parameter.title: Rhode Island goalball youth clinic
parameter.description: Regional outreach clinic; mat setup begins at noon and team gear plan is still being finalized.
parameter.location: Providence Community Recreation Center, Providence, RI

parameter.subject: Providence clinic gear update for Saturday
parameter.body: Thanks for confirming Saturday's outreach clinic. The venue can supply cones and youth masks, but it does not have adult-size blocking pads or the raised-line repair kit. Mat setup remains noon sharp so the first demonstration can start on time.

parameter.content: Cargo update for Providence: the borrowed van now only has room for two players and duffels because the back bench is staying in. I'm leaving from my aunt's place, so if Priya's rail plan holds, the club trunk is the one set of pads that can reach the venue before noon setup.

parameter.description: Coach fare from Boston South Station to Providence for the goalball clinic morning

parameter.subject: South Station Red Cap staffing advisory for April 18 departures
parameter.body: For Boston South Station departures through Saturday morning, curb-to-platform Red Cap additions are limited to requests already logged before each train's 48-hour mark. Travelers without logged assistance may still check in at the main information desk inside the station, but oversized-item curb pickup cannot be newly added for those departures.
